{{recipesummary|category=Cake recipes|yield=16 slices|time=1 hour|difficulty=4}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Valentine's Day Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham cracker]] crumbs
* 1 box (22.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Cake Mix|brownie mix]]

=== Frosting ===
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* ½ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 cup (2 sticks) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Coffee|instant espresso powder]]
* 2 tablespoons warm water

=== Decoration ===
* 1 bag Dove Rich Dark [[Cookbook:Chocolate|Chocolate]] Hearts
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] or topping

==Procedure==

=== Base ===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# Line bottom of 9-inch [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]] with waxed paper; grease.
# Add melted butter to graham cracker crumbs and press into bottom of pan.
# Prepare brownie mix according to package instructions; spread over crumbs.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] until firm, approximately 35 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
# Remove from oven to a [[Cookbook:Wire Rack|wire rack]]; cool completely and remove from pan.

=== Frosting ===
# [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] egg whites and sugar together in a bowl over [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmering]] water until sugar is dissolved.
# Remove from heat; using [[Cookbook:Mixer|electric mixer]], [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] until fluffy and cooled.
# Add butter one nugget at a time while continuing to beat.
# Dissolve espresso powder in warm water.
# Beat espresso into frosting.
# Frost top and sides of cake.

=== Finishing ===
# Snip small corner of a resealable plastic bag; place whipped cream inside.
# [[Cookbook:Piping|Pipe]] 3 rosettes around outside edges of cake.
# Place a chocolate heart atop each rosette.
# Place 8 chocolate hearts in a small resealable plastic bag.
# [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|Microwave]] until melted, about 15 seconds.
# Cut a corner of the bag; randomly drizzle chocolate on dessert plates.
# Place a cake wedge on each plate.
